comment: Omega3 and Omega6 share the spreading code in Omega.cpp and differ only in how the range is stated: Omega3 takes an offset and a scale, Omega6 takes the two end voltages. The Curve order switch has no widget on the panel and is reachable only from the right-click menu. A polyphonic cable on any of the three inputs is summed to a single value rather than read channel by channel.
